_doc: Arena 12 (retail world 44: a swamp) kit for the map editor (S36), same schema as art/arena7/kit.json (kind cap = lies over another block's top: y = 0 is that top). Pieces the arena also uses from the other kits are found by map_sheet.py.

pieces.name: peat_block
pieces.label: Bloque de turba
pieces.note: a cell-wide block of moss-grown earth under every cell; the slabs (caps) sit on it

pieces.name: earth_slab_grass
pieces.label: Losa de tierra con hierba
pieces.note: lies over the peat block: y = 0 is its top; a raised lip round a lower middle full of swamp grass; the two retail drawings only move the blades

pieces.name: earth_slab_sparse
pieces.label: Losa de tierra con poca hierba

pieces.name: earth_slab_half
pieces.label: Losa de tierra con hierba detrás
pieces.note: dense grass on the back half, bare mud in front; 1501 (owner: «losa de barro») is the same drawing

pieces.name: mud_slab
pieces.label: Losa de barro
pieces.note: a domed slab of wet mud with pale ridges

pieces.name: mud_slab_drip
pieces.label: Losa de barro que gotea
pieces.note: the mud slab with pale crests running down its front edges

pieces.name: duckweed_patch
pieces.label: Lenteja de agua
pieces.note: a mat of duckweed on the water, loose fronds round it

pieces.name: duckweed_ring
pieces.label: Lenteja de agua en corro
pieces.note: a ring of duckweed round open water

pieces.name: tendril_s
pieces.label: Zarcillo en S
pieces.note: a flat tendril floating on the water

pieces.name: murky_puddle
pieces.label: Charco turbio
pieces.note: owner: «mancha o líquido»; dark water, light on its far rims

pieces.name: mushroom_stump
pieces.label: Tocón con setas
pieces.note: a squat mossy stump crowned by a heap of shelf mushrooms; 2681 is the same in the edge's shade

pieces.name: mushroom_stump_tall
pieces.label: Tocón alto con setas
pieces.note: a big cap on top, shelves round its sides; 2682 is the same in the edge's shade

pieces.name: marsh_clump
pieces.label: Mata de musgo
pieces.note: a dark moss cushion with moss balls, paddle leaves and two spikes

pieces.name: marsh_fiddle
pieces.label: Brotes de helecho
pieces.note: a small cushion, a fiddlehead and a club stalk

pieces.name: marsh_paddles
pieces.label: Planta de palas
pieces.note: tall upright paddle leaves on dark moss

pieces.name: cotton_grass
pieces.label: Hierba algodonera
pieces.note: thin stems bowing right, white plumes drooping; 1.6 m

pieces.name: plank_raft
pieces.label: Pasarela de tablas
pieces.note: two round logs along z, planks across them, two along z on top; posts 1207/1297 hold it over the water

pieces.name: rope_posts
pieces.label: Postes con cuerda
pieces.note: a leaning post roped at its foot and top, a short roped post; they hold the walkway (1204)

pieces.name: rope_trestle
pieces.label: Caballete con cuerda
pieces.note: two posts under a crossbeam, a short roped post beside them

pieces.name: shovel
pieces.label: Pala
pieces.note: a shovel stuck in a heap of red stones

pieces.name: broken_cane
pieces.label: Caña rota
pieces.note: a thick snapped cane leaning in the mud, slime down its side, mud balls and bubbles at its foot; 1.7 m

pieces.name: vine_tall
pieces.label: Enredadera alta
pieces.note: a thick fleshy vine 3 m tall, berries at its foot, a thin vine twining up it into a hook at 4 m

pieces.name: vine_over_edge
pieces.label: Enredadera sobre el borde
pieces.note: a cut length of vine lying over the island's edge, leaves hanging down the face; y = 0 is the edge's top; turn it to face the drop

pieces.name: lianas
pieces.label: Lianas
pieces.note: three strands hanging down a cliff face from its top edge (plane x = 0 facing +x), like the arena 9 whip
